page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Running head centred at top ("GRAECA."), page number top right. Main text in one column, with Greek verb paradigms as short lines and Latin paragraphs. No notes, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: Στῆθι[?] vel στῆθι, sistito, στήτω, sistito ille.
main_text.p: Verba Quinti, Sexti, Septimi, vel Octavi futuri ali-quando sunt praesentis temporis, & frequentissime in imperando usurpantur.
main_text.l: Τύπτω, verberare. Dorice & Attice τυπτέω: Ioni-
Εἶναι, vel ἴμμαι, vel ἴμμι, vel ἠμμι[?], esse.
main_text.p: Gerundia & Supina Graeci per infinita circumlo-quuntur: Et per infinita saepe imperare solent.

page.notes: Greek forms in the verb list (first line, θὲς/στῆθι, and the Ionic and infinitive forms) are only partly legible at this scan resolution and are marked [?]. The Latin "ufurpantur" is printed with a long s that reads as f; transcribed as usurpantur. Printed hyphens at line ends (ali-quando, Ioni-ce, circumlo-quuntur) kept as printed.
